content: Alice prefers Python, Flask, and FAISS for local vector search demos.
Alice wants AWS Free Tier deployments with no managed databases or load balancers.
AegisMem connects related memories through weighted graph edges and BFS traversal.
Exact memory lookup uses a SHA-256 hash index for constant-time key retrieval.
The Flask API runs in Docker with Gunicorn and persists data on the EC2 EBS volume.
